What It Is

You’ve Built Equity. Explore Your Options.

Your home equity is the difference between what your property is worth and what you owe. There are several ways to access that value and receive cash — each with different rules and terms.

That’s why we work with a licensed broker who knows each program inside out and handles your pre-qualification. We walk you through the options and help you get everything ready from the start.

Three Ways to Access Your Equity

Your Equity Options

🏢

Fixed-Rate HELOC (Initial Draw)

Borrow against your eligible equity and repay the amount drawn plus interest. The initial draw uses a fixed rate; later draws may have different terms.

Borrow against equity. Repay the loan.
💼

P&L HELOC (Self-Employed)

Document your income with a 12- or 24-month profit-and-loss (P&L) statement — no bank statements for the income calculation. It’s a variable-rate line secured by the property.

P&L-only is how your income is documented.
🏡

Home Equity Investment (HEI)

A provider funds you in exchange for an agreed share of your home’s future value. There’s no monthly HEI payment; you keep paying your mortgage, taxes, insurance, and upkeep. A lump sum settles later, subject to a contractual cap.

No monthly payment doesn’t mean no cost.
Home Equity Investment (HEI) / Cash-Out
